caption: The drawing features a depiction of a person seated against a light grey and blue background resembling rocks or clouds. The person is dressed in a greenish tunic, with red-brown drapery over the lower body, and has a golden-yellow band on the upper arm and wrist, as well as yellow and white accents on the head, including a feathered or leafy headdress and a round earring. The figure appears to be sitting on a large, curved white and brown object that could resemble a scroll or shell. Below the figure, there is a horizontal rectangular plaque colored in brown with the word "SHANUNGA" written in bold, white, uppercase letters. On either end of the plaque, there is an image of a white shell. The drawing is set against a light beige or cream background with no other objects or decorations.
title: Sternpiece from "Shanunga"
